intent: Inspect and remedy all 92 findings in the supplied November 5 diagnostic review, preserving existing GitHub/gateway recovery, selected-profile identity, safe mutations, privacy and bounded resource use.

work_packages.scope: DNS/transport classification, bounded recovery, MCP discovery/session lifecycle and measured gateway/model readiness
Operation receipts, exact failure phases, durable objective recovery, verified completion, tool admission and result classification
Voice/input lifecycle, performance, vendor attribution and diagnostic incident reconstruction
Authorized search fallback, access failures, bounded document segmentation, complete-source evidence and PDF text/font handling
Behavior regressions, canonical host checks, Android CI and per-finding implementation evidence

acceptance.truthful_completion: Provider and tool completion must not be reported as verified task completion without objective evidence.
acceptance.recovery: Keep confirmed output and receipts; do not blindly repeat ambiguous repository mutations or switch the selected AI profile.
acceptance.external_limits: Phone/vendor, LAN, DNS/provider availability and rendering must be labeled unverified unless exercised on the corresponding environment.
acceptance.coverage: Every finding has source evidence and an implementation/existing-coverage/external-validation disposition.

focused_jvm.qualification: Targeted production-source JVM harnesses use explicit Android/HTTP boundary adapters; not a full Android build.

android_application.reason: Full JDK 21 / SDK 37 build, unit suite, heap checks, lint and packaged APK checks must pass on this branch head.
